w00-kickoff-ana-gate.observed_description: Ana (long dark wavy hair, sage-green overshirt, white top, jeans) stands at an open white garden gate and waves at the camera, smiling; behind her the party garden with lanterns, a long white table and a group of guests.
w00-kickoff-ana-gate.note: Usable as the unassessed kickoff still: Ana matches the cast reference; the guests behind her are small and unassessed.

w01-guests-arrive.observed_description: Four guests stand in a row on the lawn beside a party table with a tiered cake: a very tall young man in a light-blue shirt and khakis (left), a woman with very long straight black hair in a white floral dress, a shorter older woman with grey curly hair and a red cardigan, and a man with a thick dark beard in a brown jacket (right). Lanterns hang in the trees. Nobody else, no text.
w01-guests-arrive.note: Usable for the guided tutorial: tall, long hair and beard are unmistakable; the grey-haired woman is only somewhat shorter than the long-haired woman (head about 0.07 of the height lower), acceptable on the no-fail tutorial beat. All four are separate and inside the frame.

w02-old-and-young.observed_description: Four guests sit in a row at the party table: an old white-haired man in a grey sweater on a bench (left), a young girl with two braids in a yellow dress, an old woman with white curly hair in a blue blouse on a chair, and a young man of about 17 in a green T-shirt (right). Lanterns above. Nobody else, no text.
w02-old-and-young.note: Usable: old and young read at once for each of the four; all are separate and inside the frame.

w03-party-actions.observed_description: Garden party: a man in a striped T-shirt drinks from a white cup at a small round table (left), a blonde woman in a pink blouse eats chocolate cake from a plate with a fork, a man in a white apron grills chicken on a kettle barbecue with smoke rising, and a woman in a blue dress reads a green book in a folding chair (right). Nobody else, no text.
w03-party-actions.note: Usable: each action is unmistakable and the four are separate; the coffee is implied by the cup.

w04-swims-runs-sings-dances.observed_description: Garden party by a pool: a girl swims in the pool with both arms raised (left edge), a boy runs across the grass, a man sings with an acoustic guitar on a chair, and a woman with long red hair dances with her arms up (right). Lanterns above. Nobody else, no text.
w04-swims-runs-sings-dances.note: Usable: the four actions read at once; the swimming girl's raised arm touches the left edge but her head and body are inside the frame.

w05-pets.observed_description: Garden party, no people: a tan dog with a red collar lies on the stone patio with a yellow tennis ball in its mouth (left), a grey-and-white cat lies awake on a round grey cat bed, a yellow parakeet perches in a white domed cage on a wooden side table with a small water dish, and a white-and-brown rabbit eats lettuce and carrots from a blue bowl (right). No text.
w05-pets.note: Usable with a note: the dog with its ball, the cat on its bed and the rabbit eating its food are clear; the parakeet perches beside its water dish rather than drinking, so its cue (The bird drinks its water.) states the habit and the bird is identified as the only bird.

w06-together.observed_description: Garden party with four groups: a woman in a red dress dances with a man in a white shirt holding hands (left), a boy of about 11 in a yellow T-shirt plays football with a smaller boy and a little girl, a ball at their feet, a white-haired grandmother on a bench reads a picture book with a little girl, and a man and a woman in aprons cook at a barbecue (right). Nobody else, no text.
w06-together.note: Usable: the four groups are separate and each activity is clear. Deviation: the football player in yellow is an older boy, not a man; the cue (He plays football with them.) still fits him.

w07-drinks.observed_description: Four guests sit behind a long white table facing the camera, each holding one drink at chest height: a man in a light-blue shirt with a glass cup of amber tea (a tea tag hangs over the rim), a woman in a green blouse with a glass mug of black coffee, an older man in a grey polo with a glass of water, and a young woman in an orange top with a glass of orange juice. A cake on the table. No text.
w07-drinks.note: Usable: the four drinks are told apart at once, so He doesn't drink coffee. He drinks tea. finds only the man with tea.

w08-luis-asks.observed_description: Luis (short dark curly hair, clean-shaven, navy crew-neck T-shirt) stands in the party garden by the long table, looks at the camera with a friendly smile and holds one palm open to the side, as if asking. Nobody else.
w08-luis-asks.note: Usable as G1's question view; Luis matches the cast reference.

w09-grandmother-tea.note: Usable as G1's response view (Yes, she does.).

w10-sofia-asks.observed_description: Sofia (long curly dark hair, white blouse under a bright blue blazer) stands in the party garden and looks at the camera with a friendly smile, one palm open toward the table, as if asking. Nobody else.
w10-sofia-asks.note: Usable as G2's question view; Sofia matches the cast reference.

w11-uncle.observed_description: Ana's uncle (short grey hair, light-blue short-sleeved shirt, as in 1.4 k02) stands by the long party table holding a small plate with a slice of cake, smiling. A tiny blurred figure stands far in the background at the left.
w11-uncle.note: Usable as G2's response view (He lives in Mexico.); the background figure is tiny and unassessed.

w12-diego-asks.observed_description: Diego (dark curly hair with a little grey, short full beard, burgundy button shirt) stands by the party table and looks at the camera with a friendly smile, one palm open to the side, as if asking. Nobody else.
w12-diego-asks.note: Usable as G3's question view; Diego matches the cast reference.

w13-cousin-grandparents.observed_description: Ana's cousin (young man, mustard T-shirt) stands between his grandmother (white hair, lilac top, grey skirt) and his grandfather (white hair, white guayabera shirt) by the long party table, his arms around them, all smiling. Nobody else, no text.
w13-cousin-grandparents.note: Usable as G3's response view (He lives with my grandparents.).

w14-luis-asks-rabbit.observed_description: Luis (navy T-shirt) kneels on the grass by the party table, points at a white-and-brown rabbit eating from a small blue bowl and looks at the camera, as if asking about it. Nobody else.
w14-luis-asks-rabbit.note: Usable as G4's question view (What is its name?); Luis and the rabbit are both visible.

w15-coco-rabbit.observed_description: Close photo of the white-and-brown rabbit (as in 1.10 b04) sitting on the grass next to its blue bowl of lettuce and carrots, looking toward the camera; the party table and lanterns softly blurred behind. No people, no text.
w15-coco-rabbit.note: Usable as G4's response view (Its name is Coco.).
